domain-information: A Fire Chief develops response strategies and allocates units to different stations to optimize coverage
A Fire Chief reviews incident reports and adjusts department protocols to improve safety and efficiency
A Dispatcher receives emergency calls and coordinates the deployment of fire units
A Dispatcher communicates with firefighters in the field to provide updates and critical instructions
A Firefighter responds to emergencies and operates equipment to extinguish fires and rescue people
A Firefighter conducts safety checks on fire trucks to ensure readiness for the next call
A Training Officer organizes drills to prepare personnel for complex emergency scenarios
A Training Officer evaluates firefighter performance and updates training materials to address observed gaps

domain objects.name: Fire Chief
domain objects.description: Senior officer who directs strategy and oversees department operations

domain objects.name: Response Strategy
domain objects.description: Planned approach for allocating fire units and handling emergencies

domain objects.name: Station
domain objects.description: Facility that hosts fire units and resources

domain objects.name: Fire Unit
domain objects.description: Team of firefighters assigned to a station or deployment

domain objects.name: Firefighter
domain objects.description: Emergency responder who handles fire suppression and rescue tasks

domain objects.name: Incident Report
domain objects.description: Record describing details and outcomes of a fire incident

domain objects.name: Dispatcher
domain objects.description: Operator who receives emergency calls and coordinates deployments

domain objects.name: Field Messaging
domain objects.description: Communication exchanged between dispatcher and firefighters

domain objects.name: Safety Check
domain objects.description: Routine inspection performed to ensure equipment readiness

domain objects.name: Fire Truck
domain objects.description: Vehicle used to transport firefighters and equipment

domain objects.name: Gear
domain objects.description: Protective and operational equipment used by firefighters

domain objects.name: Training Officer
domain objects.description: Specialist responsible for drills, instruction, and skill development

domain objects.name: Drill
domain objects.description: Training exercise conducted to prepare for emergency scenarios

domain objects.name: Training Material
domain objects.description: Guides, instructions, or resources used in firefighter training

domain objects.name: Performance Evaluation
domain objects.description: Assessment of a firefighter’s skills and training progress

associations.description: Fire Chief creates and updates Response Strategy
Fire Chief allocates resources across each Station
Fire Chief reviews each Incident Report for improvements
Dispatcher receives and processes each Emergency Call
Dispatcher deploys each Fire Unit to incidents
Fire Unit responds to the Emergency Call
Firefighter exchanges Field Messaging during operations
Dispatcher sends Field Messaging to guiding firefighters
Safety Check verifies condition of the Fire Truck
Training Officer creates the Performance Evaluation
